events.name: PECO Cross Country - Race 1
events.distance: 1 mile at 10:00 (U10 and U12) / 2 miles at 10:20 (U14 and U17)
events.ageGroups: U10 to U17 - age 6 to 15 on 1 September 2026, normally school years 2 to 11
events.cost: £8 season ticket, online in advance only - covers all five races plus the relays and prize presentation
events.notes: Entries are open. The two junior races go off before the senior race and are both chip timed. The 1 mile is at 10:00 for children aged 6 to 10 on 1 September 2026, and the 2 miles is at 10:20 for those aged 11 to 15. Prizes go to boys and girls in four groups - U10, U12, U14 and U17. There is no entry on the day - the only way in is to buy the season ticket online in advance, so enter early to be sure of a place. The price covers race fees, card charges and admin, with nothing else to pay. You collect a race number with a timing chip in it at the first race you go to, and keep the same number all season - turn up and run after that. A replacement costs £2.50 at Race HQ. You do not have to be a paid member of a running club, but you do need to name the club you are connected with. Only enter your child if you are confident they can run the distance; for the younger race, junior parkrun is a good guide. Dates and venues are still subject to landowner approval. Race HQ and toilets are in The Courtyard at Temple Newsam; the start and finish are on the field in front of Temple Newsam House, about a five minute walk away. There is no water, no baggage store and no changing rooms. The race is capped at 700 entries.

events.name: Leeds Relays
events.distance: 1 mile (U10 and U12) / 2 miles (U14 and U16) / relay teams of four with 2 mile legs (U18 and U20)
events.notes: Hosted by the University of Leeds Cross Country Society, who have invited the club - tell a coach if you would like to run. Registration closes at 10:30, half an hour before the first race. Junior start times: 11:00 U10 boys, 11:05 U10 girls, 11:20 U12 boys, 11:25 U12 girls, 11:40 U14 boys, 11:45 U14 girls, 12:20 U16 boys, 12:25 U16 girls. Boys and girls start together but are timed separately. U18 and U20 run in the relays with the seniors at 13:00 (women) and 14:00 (men and mixed).

events.name: Northern Athletics November Indoor Open
events.venue: English Institute of Sport (EIS), Coleridge Road, Sheffield, S9 5DA
events.distance: Indoor track and field. U14 and U16: 60m, 600m, 1000m, long jump, shot, pole vault. U18 and U20: 60m, 150m, 1000m, 2000m, shot, pole vault, triple jump
events.ageGroups: U14, U16, U18 and U20 (seniors too) - age groups as at 31 August 2027. No U12 events
events.notes: An indoor track and field meeting, not a cross country race. You need a valid England Athletics competition licence. U14 and U16 can enter up to 3 events, U18 up to 4. Entries close at 18:00 on Friday 13 November and there are no entries on the day. The organiser expects a lot of interest and may hand entries back if limits are reached. Collect your number on the day. The first track event is at 10:15 and the track runs on a rolling timetable, so each race starts as soon as the one before finishes - the running order is on the Northern Athletics website. U14 and U16 are seeded together, as are U18 and U20 with the seniors. Four attempts in long jump, triple jump and shot, and shot uses your own age group's weight. You will be asked for a season's best when entering; a best guess is fine if you do not have one. Entries cannot be passed to someone else, and refunds are only given if the organiser cancels.

events.name: West Yorkshire XC League - Race 1
events.distance: 2500m (U12) / 3500m (U14) / 4000m (U16 girls) / 5000m (U16 boys and U18 women) / 6500m (U18 men)
events.ageGroups: U12, U14, U16 and U18, with separate races for boys and girls. Junior ages are taken as at 31 August 2027, so U12 runners must be born on or before 31 August 2017 - there is no U10 race
events.notes: Meeting 1 of 5. Enter in advance through the SportSoft system linked from the league page - there are no entries on the day. One £25 fee covers the whole league. Entries for this first meeting close on 4 October; if you miss that, entries reopen afterwards for the remaining four. Every runner needs an up to date England Athletics registration. You collect a league number at this meeting - keep it for the rest of the season. Races start no earlier than: 11:45 U12 girls, 11:55 U12 boys, 12:05 U14 girls, 12:20 U14 boys, 12:40 U16 girls, 12:55 U16 boys, 13:00 U18 women, 13:20 U18 men.
